notes: Company financial-year label names the year beginning1April; this file uses the following March calendar year. Full yen values scaled from published yen millions.
US GAAP throughFY2013 calendar end; IFRS comparative fromFY2014. The2016report also shows overlapping USGAAP2014–15 but latest IFRS figures are chosen.

Net income and equity are attributable to Hitachi stockholders. Older2016employee data are retrospectively presented excluding temporary employees; recent employees are Hitachi Group, not parent-only.

Under USGAAP the company explicitly labels operating income on its Japanese-comparison presentation (revenues less cost of sales and SG&A); this excludes some charges classified in operating income under standardUSGAAP. IFRS table only gives Adjusted operating income and EBIT; neither is silently substituted for unadjusted operatingIncome.

Capex2017–2026 is the directly published Capital expenditures (CF basis) negative-normalized;2016andearlier property/plant/equipment investment summary lacks required cash-basis designation, retained null.

Recent dividends/per-share data reflect stock-consolidation/split adjustments in2026report; older data retain2016reportbasis. Current report notes ongoingportfolio changes; most recent table used for2017–2026.
Cash equivalents and shares outstanding are not derived from other lines. Recent basicEPS is not used for dilutedEPS; dilutedEPS only populated from directly labeled2016data.
